newsitem.title: ESTONIA: RAKVERE RIGA PLANT GETS NEW MANAGERS, BOARD.
newsitem.headline: RAKVERE RIGA PLANT GETS NEW MANAGERS, BOARD.

text.p: The Rigas Miesnieks meat factory, owned by Estonia's Rakvere, voted at an extraordinory meeting to change the membership of its board and management, Rakvere said on Monday.
In a statement, Rakvere said that the board chairman will be Toomas Kouhna and new board members will be Harijs Tarvans and Andrus Mottus.
The management will include Juris Lusis as chairman, Aarne Alder and Heinrihs Norbets.
Iona Dvarza is a also candiate member of the management board.
Rakvere, which is traded on the free market of the Tallinn stock exchange, bought 67 percent of the Latvian plant in May.
